name: openspec-status
description: Shows the OpenSpec changes of the open project under the prompt, for local roots and stores, and warns in any project when the context fills up.

contextWarningPercent.title: Context warning (%)
contextWarningPercent.description: Context fill, in percent of the model's window, that shows the first warning. 0 turns it off. Applies when the plugin is next loaded.

contextCriticalPercent.title: Context critical (%)
contextCriticalPercent.description: Context fill, in percent of the model's window, that shows the second warning. 0 turns it off. Applies when the plugin is next loaded.
